scope: Final read-only comparison of matrix, actual frozen files, both Java admissions and matching finite verification receipts against the already reviewed runner/freezer. No build, server launch, workload, or campaign script execution.

checkedWithoutBlocker.basis: Original run.py reaped()/execute()/stop_and_join(): waitid(WNOWAIT), one owner wait4, then child.returncode assignment. The campaign heartbeat reads JSONL only and does not poll/reap client or server PIDs.
checkedWithoutBlocker.conclusion: No new competing wait/poll owner found.

checkedWithoutBlocker.basis: run_cell creates each cell directory with exist_ok=False. SQLite uses a fresh seed copy; PostgreSQL data directory is inside that new cell directory and original observer initdb creates a new cluster. The independent fixture verifier compares every customer/order/line plus metadata/schema/indexes before and after.
checkedWithoutBlocker.conclusion: No cross-cell database reuse or count-only verification found.

checkedWithoutBlocker.basis: Original observer always produces postgresql://korda@127.0.0.1:<dynamic-port>/db_perf_01. Campaign converts Java only to jdbc:postgresql://127.0.0.1:<port>/db_perf_01?user=korda&sslmode=disable. Java Database.open accepts JDBC URLs and uses the PostgreSQL driver directly.
checkedWithoutBlocker.conclusion: Conversion matches this exact fixed-user/dedicated-server contract.

checkedWithoutBlocker.basis: The environment override wraps only observer.execute/client launch, after PostgreSQL startup and fixture setup. memoryEnforcementClaimed is false. The policy explicitly excludes a PostgreSQL/Java cap.
checkedWithoutBlocker.conclusion: No accidental PostgreSQL 192 MiB cap found; final C# override values require matrix inspection.

checkedWithoutBlocker.basis: Updated evaluate checks 1800 offered seconds, exact planned and attempted rate*1800, accounting equalities, monotonic boundaries, histogram populations, per-second totals, case order, fixed settings and 15-second released idle. These field names match C# Shared/OfferedLoad.cs and Java OfferedLoad/Main receipts.
checkedWithoutBlocker.conclusion: No schema mismatch found in the updated validator.

checkedWithoutBlocker.basis: Fresh cell directories, original observer refuses existing raw evidence, unsuccessful status raises after preserved cell status/events, and all exceptions unwind the original PostgreSQL owner context for bounded stop/join.
checkedWithoutBlocker.conclusion: No automatic retry or silent failed-cell overwrite found.

checkedWithoutBlocker.basis: validate_matrix runs before --validate-only can succeed and before the observer/server/client is launched. Exact generated cell names are enforced, including the heartbeat/command evidence name match.
checkedWithoutBlocker.conclusion: The previously reported launch-setting gap is closed for the generated campaign.

checkedWithoutBlocker.basis: Dapper build-receipt executableSha256 is checked. EF publishedArtifacts, RuntimeImages and sourceFilesSha256 are checked before complete publish-directory freeze. Java requires a passed finite-verification summary matching build-identity executableSha256, then checks the executable and source hashes. Original manifest uses queries/name and is checked against the owner policy hash.
checkedWithoutBlocker.conclusion: No additional static binding mismatch found. The final Java receipt contents and final generated matrix must still be checked when available.

measurementCautions.finding: Original observer wait4 counters are process-lifetime values, not the steady 1800-second cost. Client steady cost must use consumer monotonic boundaries; PostgreSQL tree snapshots are non-atomic and raw identities/reaped counts must be retained.

pg_stats-before/after deliberately bracket fixture verification, consumer warmup/drain/idle as applicable. Their deltas are not pure steady-phase server costs; the source labels that scope accurately.

resolvedFindings.resolution: run_cell now verifies both cell and global frozen inputs after clean database retirement.
The initial host.json is retained. Resume compares hostName/bootId/matrixSha256/ownerMemoryPolicy; each invocation appends a separate observation.

validate_matrix checks exact eight-cell order/names, CPUs0-3, timeout2115, one copy of required command values, --verify, excluded diagnostics, C#0xC000000 and Java admission flag. Unknown --only is rejected.
freeze_matrix now compares Dapper ELF against the build receipt, and EF publishedArtifacts plus actual loaded RuntimeImages against the validated attempt03 hashes before creating the new freeze.
